summary: Batch QA Phase C FRONTEND regression (CR-097, CR-085-A, CR-085-A2) on preprod. All 9 flows PASS at functional level. 1 MINOR UI regression (horizontal overflow on /customers at 390px) and 1 NOTE on UX (phone input in Add/Edit Customer dialog sanitizes to digits-only + maxLength=10 so a literal '+91 98765 43955' cannot be typed into the phone field — country code is a separate dropdown; backend still accepts the formatted string via API when sent). Baseline customers count 7700 confirmed at run start and run end — all test data cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 390px viewport: document.body.scrollWidth=473 vs clientWidth=390 (3 offending elements overflow right edge). Other pages (/coupons /profile /dashboard) have no overflow at same viewport.

issues: NOTE (UX, not a regression): the phone <Input> uses onChange=e.target.value.replace(/\\D/g,'') and maxLength=10. This means the user cannot type/paste a formatted international number like '+91 98765 43955' into the phone field — spaces, '+' and leading country code are stripped on the fly. Country code is picked from a separate dropdown. Backend normalisation DOES accept the formatted string (verified via direct POST /api/customers), but the UI design prevents end-users from entering it. If Phase C spec intended to test backend normalisation through the UI with '+91 98765 43955', that path is not reachable in the UI — digits-only '9876543955' + '+91' dropdown is the equivalent flow and works correctly, saving phone='9876543955'. Same constraint applies to the Edit dialog (data-testid=edit-list-phone-input). Consider either (a) relaxing input sanitisation to allow '+', spaces and leading-0 (lets normalisation happen server-side as designed) or (b) updating spec to use digits-only input in UI assertions.

feature_results.F7_guest_order_renders: PASS — Created guest order via POST /api/pos/orders with cust_mobile '0000000000' → 200 {data: {customer_id:null, guest_order:true, guest_reason:'invalid_phone'}}. Owner UI then loaded /dashboard, /customers, /analytics, /coupons, /profile, /wallet, /loyalty — all rendered without blank/crash/error banner (body length >200 chars, no 'Something went wrong'). No standalone /orders page exists in this build (RecentOrders / /orders / Orders route not present). Guest order is NOT surfaced in any customer-named list (customer_id=null means it has no owning customer row to attach to in /customers). Dashboard stats include an Orders counter that still works.
feature_results.F8_crm_events_15_cards: PASS — /whatsapp-automation CRM Events tab shows 'All (15)' chip, 'Welcome Message' card present, 'Reset Password (OTP)' NOT present. (POS Events tab also visible as the other tab, not asserted.)
feature_results.F9_smoke_console_errors_and_overflow: PARTIAL — Desktop (1920x800): 0 filtered console errors across /customers,/coupons,/profile,/dashboard. Mobile (390x844): 0 filtered console errors. HORIZONTAL OVERFLOW: /customers body.scrollWidth=473 > clientWidth=390 (3 offenders) — see ui_bugs.MINOR. /coupons /profile /dashboard overflow=false.

action_items: MINOR: Investigate and fix horizontal overflow on /customers at 390px (3 elements extend beyond clientWidth=390 to right=473). Likely offenders are the stats-chip row (Total: 157 / Bronze / Silver / Gold) or the Export+Import+Add header-button cluster. Add overflow-x:hidden to the page root or make the chip/header row wrap on mobile.

NOTE: Phase C spec for F3/F4 asked us to type formatted phone '+91 98765 43955' / '0 98765 43955' into the Add/Edit Customer phone field. The field strips non-digits via onChange (CustomersPage.jsx L1910 for Add, L2452 for Edit) and has maxLength=10. Backend normalisation handles formatted input correctly (verified by curl), so either relax the UI sanitiser (allow +, spaces, leading 0 — let backend normalise), or update the QA plan to reflect digits-only UI contract.
NO ACTION NEEDED for CR-097 removals — verified clean (no /login reset link, no /register route, no 'Reset Password (OTP)' event card, no sidebar/profile Reset Password item).
critical_code_review_comments: CustomersPage.jsx L1910 and L2452: onChange sanitiser `value.replace(/\\D/g,'')` + maxLength=10 blocks user from entering formatted phone strings. Backend normalize_phone() in /app/backend/core/phone.py already handles +91/0/space-separated forms; the UI sanitiser is redundant and prevents the Phase C regression path from being exercised through the UI.

CR-097 cleanup verified clean in LoginPage.jsx, DashboardPage.jsx (L213 comment confirming Reset Password removal), ResponsiveLayout.jsx, WhatsAppAutomationContent.jsx (no 'reset password' or 'otp' references), App.js (L43 comment '/register removed, staff accounts come from POS').

No standalone /orders page in /app/frontend/src/pages — F7 could not assert order rendering in a dedicated orders view. Guest orders are correctly invisible from the customer-centric views since customer_id is null (expected per CR-085-A2 design).

success_rate.frontend: 9/9 features functionally PASS. 1 MINOR UI bug (overflow). 1 UX NOTE (phone input constraint).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline customers count stays at 7700 after this iter 7 run. All CR-097 removals verified clean in UI. CR-085-A canonical phone + CSV dedup verified in UI. CR-085-A2 guest-order creation does not crash any CRM UI page. The only reproducible UI issue is horizontal overflow on /customers at 390px (bodySW=473, 3 offenders). For future UI tests on the Add/Edit Customer phone field: the input only accepts digits (max 10) — fill() formatted strings will be stripped on the fly; use digits-only + separate country code dropdown '[data-testid="country-code-select"]' / '[data-testid="edit-country-code-select"]' or bypass maxLength via `element.maxLength = 15` before fill() to simulate pasting 11-digit leading-0 form.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regression. The one MINOR UI finding (horizontal overflow on /customers at 390px) is a layout bug: specific elements in the Customers page header or stats-chip row have fixed width or lack flex-wrap/truncate on mobile, pushing document.body.scrollWidth to 473px on a 390px viewport. Reproduction: set viewport {width:390,height:844}, navigate to /customers (logged in), check document.body.scrollWidth > clientWidth. Mitigation: add `overflow-x: hidden` on page root or `flex-wrap: wrap` + `min-width:0` on the Total/Bronze/Silver/Gold chip row and the header button cluster (Sync MyGenie / Export / Import / Add).
